name: Ramen no Oujisama
source:
This is a hentai visual novel that chronicles the loves and tribulations of a young man who, thanks to a generous benefactor, is starting fresh in a new city and opening a new ramen restaurant. Along the way, he meets an eclectic cast of characters, and eventually must learn to juggle business with pleasure. Can he get the girl of his dreams?

[From [url=http://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/676178]Newgrounds description[/url]]
